subject: pufferfish
pitch: A startled pufferfish fully puffed up into a ball. Creamy yellow skin with brown leopard spots on top fading to a white belly, short spikes all over, a tiny pouting mouth, big worried round eyes, small fluttering side fins and a stubby fan-shaped tail. A few bubbles rise from its mouth.

I'm trying to reconstruct the chain and sweep API from the cheat sheet since the full reference docs weren't included — figuring out likely signatures for joint, chain, and sweep calls (parent, role, radius, color options) based on inference rather than exact spec, which feels risky but necessary to proceed.

I'm also considering giving the body a slightly elongated egg shape rather than a perfect sphere, since puffed pufferfish are usually a bit longer front-to-back, so I'd scale the geometry axes unevenly (slightly more in x and z than y).
